name: tracker-claude-launch-health
goal: Prove the native Tracker refuses and flags a Claude launch when the configured CLI is signed out or onboarding is incomplete.

evidence: Frontier run 39 on MB2 reported running while Claude showed first-run theme/login. Configured MB2 Claude auth status exited 1. A managed launch must refuse and flag before creating a pane when the local account is unsigned or onboarding is incomplete.

Managed-worker roundtrip verifies argv and tmux receipts but has no setup-state fixture. Expand its existing Claude fixture and the foreground dispatch workload to assert refusal, no attempt pane, and an actionable Tracker flag.
